title: Context Engineering for Trustworthiness: Rescorla–Wagner Steering Under Mixed and Inappropriate Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying how LLMs prioritize conflicting contextual signals by measuring response consistency and cleanliness across varying proportions of injected inappropriate content, using an adapted Rescorla-Wagner model to map the model's behavioral curves.

Controlling and evaluating the effect of input ordering by evenly rotating appropriate and inappropriate context segments across all positions within the prompt sequence to average out positional effects.

Evaluating a 'Cleanliness' metric using an LLM-as-a-judge to detect if the model incorporates injected hate speech—including gender discrimination, racial disparagement, and religious propaganda—into its generated responses.
